analysis.summary: The PR introduces a potential UI regression by replacing mandatory product title fields with an optional field without a fallback, and risks sending 'undefined' as a language parameter to the backend API.

bugs.title: UI Regression: Missing Product Title Fallback
bugs.description: The component replaced the mandatory heading fields (headingLine1 and headingLine2) with 'subHeadingSection.productName'. However, in 'index.types.ts', 'productName' is defined as an optional field (? string).
bugs.risk: If the API response (pcpDetail) does not contain a productName, the cart item will be rendered with an empty heading, making it impossible for the user to identify the service item they are viewing or removing.

bugs.title: BFF API Parameter Mismatch: language context risk
bugs.description: The utility function 'pcpReserveStock' now requires a 'language: string' parameter, which is used directly in a fetch URL. In 'update-pcp-reserve-stock/index.ts', this value is destructured from the BFF handler arguments without validation or a default value.
bugs.risk: If the BFF framework does not provide the 'language' property in the handler context, the value will be 'undefined'. This results in a backend request to a URL containing 'lang=undefined', which can cause the API to return incorrect data or a 400 Bad Request error.

notBugs.reason: While new translation keys like 'descPCPConfirmation' are used, it is speculative to assume they are missing from the i18n JSON files which are not part of this PR's scope.
The removal of the 'showFunctionalities' prop and the 'activatedAuto' label appears to be an intentional simplification of the UI logic for PCP items.
